# RACS Projects - MEP Engineering & Contracting

> RACS Projects is a premier MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) engineering and contracting firm based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We deliver end-to-end design, installation, testing, commissioning, and AMC maintenance solutions for residential, commercial, industrial, healthcare, and infrastructure projects across India.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: RACS Projects
- **Industry**: MEP Engineering & Contracting (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Fighting, BMS/ELV)
- **Headquarters**: Plot No. 1295 & 1296, Flat No. 303, 3rd Floor, SR White House, Venkata Ramana Colony, Gokul Plots, KPHB, Hyderabad - 500 072, Telangana, India.
- **Phone**: +91 88010 09297, +91 81064 12008
- **Email**: contact@racsprojects.in
- **Website**: https://racsprojects.com/

## Core Services (Strict Portfolio Sequence)
1. **Fire Fighting Systems**: Complete fire protection, hydrant systems, automatic sprinkler networks, fire alarm panels, FM200 suppression, and NFPA / NBC compliant safety solutions.
2. **HVAC & Ventilation**: Central chilled water plants, VRF/VRV air conditioning, ventilation ducting, cleanroom HVAC, stairwell pressurization, and energy-efficient cooling.
3. **Electrical Systems**: High voltage transformer substations, main LT distribution panels, DG backup sets, internal lighting & power wiring, cable tray management, and lightning protection.
4. **Plumbing Systems**: Water supply hydro-pneumatic booster pumps, drainage & sewerage networks, rainwater harvesting, STPs, solar water heating, and sanitary fixtures installation.
5. **BMS & ELV Systems**: Building Management Systems (BMS), CCTV video surveillance, access control, public address (PA) systems, data networking, structured cabling, and smart automation.
